tasks.task: Switch the scale on and tare it.
Switch the scale on and change the unit to carats.
Switch the scale on, wait until it is ready, have the block placed on the pan and report its weight in grams.
Switch the scale on, change the unit to ounces, have the block placed on the pan, report the reading, then switch the scale off.
Switch the scale on, enter the piece-counting mode, then leave it again so the display shows grams.
